# Demographic and baseline characteristics

```{r}
#| label: demographics

tlf_demographics(adsl) |>
  tbl_nordvale(
    title = "Table 14.1.2: Demographic and baseline characteristics",
    subtitle = "Randomised population",
    source_note = "Continuous variables are summarised as mean (standard deviation); median [minimum, maximum]."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: demographics-numbers

age_mean <- mean(adsl[["AGE"]])
female <- sum(adsl[["SEX"]] == "Female")
```

The treatment groups were comparable at baseline.
The mean age was `r sprintf("%.1f", age_mean)` years and `r female` subjects (`r sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * female / nrow(adsl))`) were female, with no clinically relevant imbalance between groups in age, sex, race or ethnicity.
